name: what-i-saw-when-i-was-a-kid
description: An endless book of childhood memories

scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && (uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000 || uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000)
scripts.test: cd apps/api && uv run pytest tests/ -v
scripts.test:api: cd apps/api && (uv run pytest tests/ -v || pytest tests/ -v)
scripts.seed: cd apps/api && uv run python seed.py
scripts.character: npm run character:convert && npm run character:extract && npm run character:optimise && npm run character:verify
scripts.tools:setup: python3 -m venv .venv-tools && .venv-tools/bin/pip install --upgrade pip && .venv-tools/bin/pip install lxml cairosvg svgwrite numpy pillow
